rdfs:label: FAQPage
rdfs:comment: A web page that answers commonly-asked questions on a particular topic.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:WebPage`. Pair with `schema:mainEntity` listing `schema:Question` resources (NOT `urn:solid:Question`, which is the ActivityStreams poll), each with `schema:acceptedAnswer` → `urn:solid:Answer`. Heavily used by Google for FAQ rich results. The page itself models multiple Q&As, distinct from a forum where each Question is a separate page.

https://schema.org/acceptedAnswer.https://schema.org/text: A canonical RDF term registry for Solid.

history.note: Example and notes use schema:Question/schema:name (urn:solid:Question is the AS poll); added notToBeConfusedWith urn:solid:Question.
